verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the implemented charge-status indication behavior: no separate charge LED and display through the main-board SK6812 chain on GPIO13.
The client identifies a material unresolved component-population decision for R6 while D1 is DNP.
The client changes the charge-status hardware by requiring a CHGLED connector, a populated 270Ω R6, and an unpopulated on-board D1; no obsolete top-level key requires removal.
